title: Elementary standard elements are strictly standard
statement: Let A be a finitely presented algebra over a commutative ring R [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Every elementary standard element a of A over R is strictly standard over R [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element].

source.place: Definition Tag 07C7 (definition-strictly-standard), and Lemma Tag 07F5 fourth paragraph

proof.text: Unpack the elementary standard presentation with n variables, m relations and c initial columns. Take the subset s of the first c variables. Its cardinality is c; its increasing enumeration is Fin.castLE by Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique. Give coefficient b to s and coefficient zero to every other c-element subset. The sum over all subsets reduces to the chosen term, and Matrix.det_transpose identifies its determinant with the elementary one. Retain the identical relation-ideal condition. This argument also works for c=0, when s is empty and the empty determinant is 1.
